cond_0257.intro: To provide Financial Control, Reporting, Analysis, and Oversight for [Company name masked] [Location masked] Region Business. Support the regional management structure by providing clear and accurate financial results and analysis to enable the local management to make informed financial decisions and plans, while also ensuring compliance with company and statutory financial guidelines. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with financial reporting and analysis in a regional business environment.
cond_0257.responsibilities: Demonstrates a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to safety policies in all work environments and areas. Prepare financial and operational reports and analysis to support the business decision making. Provide advice and counsel business unit and executive management on the financial consequences of business decisions. Responsible for collecting, analyzing and compiling data from all accounting functions necessary for monthly reporting. Coordinate, support and manage the regional budgeting, forecasting, and planning process. Direct the development, preparation and maintenance of various financial and operational plans and reports. Develop and implement control systems to ensure compliance with company financial policy and statutory requirements. Educate management and staff on financial processes/policies and the financial impact of business and operational decisions. Focus on cost controlling and reduction initiatives and ensure that unfavorable variances are addressed in a timely manner.

Ability to be responsive and persuasive at all levels of the organization

MS Office proficiency
Financial modeling experience in Excel and in Planning Programs
